name: Great Mosque and Hospital of Divriği
description: Tucked below a hilltop citadel in the small town of Divriği, in Sivas Province, this mosque and its attached hospital were built in 1228–29 by the local Mengujekid dynasty. The plain stone walls inside give way to astonishingly lavish carving around the three doorways, where stone seems to flow like lace. Look up to see the intricate vaulting beneath the two domes.
